prompt_md: A vault has several locks that must all be opened, and each of 5 directors holds keys to some of them. Any 3 directors together can open it, but no 2 can. Fewest locks?
prompt_short: 5 directors, any 3 open the vault, no 2 can. Fewest locks?
hint_md: Every pair of directors needs a lock that neither of them can open.
explain_intuition_md: One lock per director feels natural, but it doesn't work. Each pair of directors must be stopped by a lock they both lack, and if one lock stopped two different pairs, those pairs together make 3 or more people who still couldn't open it. So each of the 10 pairs needs its own lock, with keys going to the other 3 directors.
